scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm run db:generate
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:reset && bash scripts/seed-database.sh

auditConfig.//: Two classes of advisory. (1) NO override needed — brace-expansion / fast-uri / js-yaml / nanoid / form-data / qs / vite: every parent (minimatch, fast-json-stringify, json-schema-resolver, @eslint/eslintrc, postcss-as-nanoid-parent, direct ranges) already declares a semver range that admits the patched release, so a lockfile refresh resolves them naturally; carrying an override for these only papers over a stale lockfile. (2) Overrides below ARE load-bearing — the parent pins/caps the transitive BELOW its patch, so a refresh can't reach it: @fastify/swagger-ui pins @fastify/static, drizzle-kit's @esbuild-kit pins esbuild, next pins postcss (~8.4.x) and sharp, @sentry/nextjs@8 pins rollup, node-cron pins uuid@8. The real fix for each is upgrading the owning dep — notably the @sentry/nextjs v8->v10 upgrade, which also clears the one deferred medium (@opentelemetry/core GHSA-8988, fixed in otel 2.8.0 but blocked by Sentry v8's otel ^1.30.1 pin). ignoreGhsas is empty — nothing suppressed; the remaining otel moderate doesn't gate CI (audit runs at --audit-level=high).
